text:
You didn't follow the show very well, did you?
Did a federal panel of judges and the Texas supreme court declare some districts in Texas were in violation of the voting rights act?
Yes , a federal panel of judges ruled that some of Texas' congressional districts violated the U.S. Constitution and the Voting Rights Act, specifically citing intentional discrimination in their drawing. This ruling invalidated the congressional map created by Texas Democrat lawmakers in 2011. The Texas Supreme Court directed the Texas Legislature to redraw those districts, and the Texas Legislature just finished voting and approving the new districts.
